name: diskclean-mcp-server
description: Find dev caches, large unused videos and old logs, then move approved items to the OS trash.
long_description: Ask Claude to free up disk space. It scans for node_modules and other build caches, large videos you have not opened in months, and stale log files, shows you the list, and moves only the items you approve to the OS trash so you can restore them. System folders are always protected.

tools.name: get_os_env_paths
tools.description: List the usual cache and log folders on this OS

tools.name: analyze_disk_usage
tools.description: Show what is using space under a folder, by category and subfolder

tools.name: scan_cleanup_targets
tools.description: Find cleanup candidates without deleting anything (dry run)

tools.name: move_to_trash
tools.description: Move approved items from a scan to the OS trash

prompts.name: cleanup_workflow
prompts.description: Guide a safe scan, review and trash workflow
prompts.text: Free up disk space with the diskclean tools. Target: ${arguments.target_path}
